Hi Alice/Marissa —

Quick technical details for allowlisting and sandbox access:

1) Egress/IPs: for the hosted staging endpoints please allowlist the following CIDRs (outbound from Acme to Redwood staging):
- 34.205.120.0/24
- 52.23.10.0/24
If you need single static IPs for an appliance-style allowlist we can provide a small set of NAT egress addresses; tell me and I'll escalate to infra.

2) Endpoints (staging):
- https://staging.api.redwood-inference.example/v1/generate
- https://staging.api.redwood-inference.example/v1/embeddings

3) Sandbox API keys: we can issue an ephemeral sandbox API key scoped to the Acme POC. To get this to you securely we can either:
  a) create a short-lived key and share via our secure portal (preferred), or
  b) if your compliance requires, we can add an Acme service account and rotate keys via your KMS integration.

4) Test accounts & quotas: we will provision a "POC-Sandbox" account with token quota tuned for interactive load tests (we typically set 200k tokens/day for the session). If you need higher concurrency for load tests, flag the expected RPS and we'll bump the pool.

I've attached the updated network-requirements spreadsheet that includes ports and example curl commands.

Sample curl (staging):
```
curl -H "Authorization: Bearer <SANDBOX_KEY>" \
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
  -d '{"input":"Hello world"}' \
  https://staging.api.redwood-inference.example/v1/generate
```

If you can confirm your preferred method for receiving the key and the RPS target for load testing, I'll get the key and the quotas provisioned before the session.

Cheers,
Dev Patel
Platform Engineer | Redwood Inference
dev_patel@redwood.ai
Attachment: network-requirements.xlsx (xlsx)
